blind.description: A tight cluster of unlit wax pillar candles of varying heights, rendered in a warm pale yellow wax color. Melted wax drips down the sides and pools together at the base, fusing the candles into a single solid group that sits flat on the floor. Each candle has a recessed top with a short black wick protruding from the center. There are no active flames or glow effects.
blind.from_above: A compact arrangement of round candle tops with central black dots (wicks), resembling a small honeycomb or bundle of cells.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely small, approximately one-tenth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7-9 inches tall and wide).
